Use the horizontal slider or Left/Right buttons to navigate wide heatmaps without browser back gestures. Hover or tap a tile for mean TPM, contributing cell-line count and member names. Values are arithmetic means of original TPM. Ranking uses arithmetic means of the displayed expression measurements, not statistical enrichment.
